promotion_policy: Cross-type fuzzy title matches are distinct entities, not duplicates.
Custom GPT identity is deduplicated by ChatGPT GPT ID before title.
Funding tool rows sharing a source key with calculator rows are represented once as calculators.
Planned calculator concepts are retained with planned status because ResourceGrid tracks planned assets as well as live assets.
Unclassified candidates and unresolved external relationship references remain in the review queue.
Vercel implemented_by relationships are reconstructed from explicit github_repo fields rather than accepting self-referential candidate IDs.
